note: Labelled prompts for `npm run eval-routing` (python3 routing/reflex_router.py --eval). Each case runs as a first-turn request with the tools Bash, Read, Edit, Grep offered. sensitivity: public / application / restricted / proprietary. tier: small / medium / large, the smallest model that does the task well. Failing: a tier two levels too low, or restricted / proprietary content classified as public / application. `why` says what makes a case tricky.
